title: CHAPTER 10: CURRENT AFFAIRS AND RECENT DEVELOPMENTS

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Gujarat features 4 UNESCO World Heritage Sites: Champaner-Pavagadh Archaeological Park, Rani ki Vav in Patan, Historic City of Ahmedabad, and Dholavira.
The Space Applications Centre (SAC) in Ahmedabad is a primary center of ISRO, crucial for developing communication and remote sensing payloads.
Infrastructure advancements in the state are highlighted by GIFT City (Gujarat International Finance Tec-City) and the Dholera Special Investment Region (SIR).
Environmental and disaster management updates include response frameworks for extreme weather events such as Cyclone Biparjoy in Saurashtra and Kutch.
Bullet Train Project: Mumbai–Ahmedabad High Speed Rail (MAHSR) — India's first bullet train corridor; Japanese Shinkansen technology; 508 km corridor; foundation laid in September 2017.
GIFT City: Now a major IFSC (International Financial Services Centre); home to NSE IFSC, BSE IFSC, insurance and banking entities.
Dholera SIR: Dholera Special Investment Region — greenfield smart industrial city near Ahmedabad; part of Delhi-Mumbai Industrial Corridor.
Greenfield Airport: New Dholera International Airport under development.
Surat Metro: Under construction; first metro project in Surat city.
Ahmedabad Metro: Phase 1 operational; Phase 2 under construction.
Morbi Bridge Collapse (2022): Suspension bridge over Machhu River collapsed on October 30, 2022, resulting in mass casualties.

blocks.content: Gujarat represents a unique blend of ancient heritage and modern technological advancement, housing four UNESCO World Heritage Sites alongside state-of-the-art space and infrastructure projects.

rows: Only complete and unchanged Islamic pre-Mughal city
Subterranean stepwell built during Solanki Dynasty featured on ₹100 note
First city in India to be declared a UNESCO World Heritage City
Harappan city famous for advanced water conservation systems

items: Kutch Earthquake (2001): January 26, 2001 — devastating earthquake measuring 7.6 on Richter scale; epicenter at Bhuj; over 20,000 deaths; massive reconstruction effort followed.
Cyclones: Gujarat is prone to cyclones — Cyclone Tauktae (2021) severely affected Gujarat's coastline.
Dholavira UNESCO: In July 2021, Dholavira (Kutch) was inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site — Gujarat's 4th UNESCO site.
Dholavira was inscribed as India's 40th UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2021, representing the Harappan Civilization.
Rani ki Vav (Stepwell) is featured on the reverse side of the modern ₹100 banknote.
Space Applications Centre (SAC), one of the key arms of ISRO responsible for satellite payload development, is situated in Ahmedabad.
Chandrayaan-3 (2023): ISRO's successful lunar lander mission; SAC Ahmedabad developed key payloads.
Aditya-L1 (2023): India's first solar mission; PRL Ahmedabad played key role in instrument development.
